home.title: React Template
home.subtitle: React ilovalari uchun tayyor asos: tipli routing, server holati, i18n va Docker orqali deploy — hammasi sozlangan, darhol kod yozishni boshlang.

health.title: Backend holati
health.unreachableHint: Bu kutilgan holat — shablon backendsiz ham ishlaydi. django-template'ni ishga tushiring yoki VITE_API_BASE_URL orqali o'z API manzilingizni ko'rsating — karta yashil bo'ladi.

about.title: Shablon haqida
about.intro: Production React ilovalari uchun minimal, ammo to'liq skelet. Odatda loyihaning birinchi haftasida qo'lda sozlanadigan hamma narsa allaqachon yig'ilgan va Feature-Sliced Design bo'yicha tashkil etilgan.

includes.routing: TanStack Router bilan tipga xavfsiz, code-split routing
includes.query: TanStack Query va sozlangan QueryClient bilan server holati
includes.ui: Tailwind CSS 4 va shadcn/ui primitivlari, qorong'u mavzu bilan
includes.i18n: Tilni avtomatik aniqlaydigan i18next (ru / en / uz)
includes.env: Runtime muhit o'zgaruvchilari — barcha muhitlar uchun bitta image
includes.quality: Qat'iy TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier va Vitest

layers.app: Ilova yig'uvi: kirish nuqtasi, providerlar, router
layers.features: Foydalanuvchi amallari: mavzu va tilni almashtirish
layers.entities: Biznes ma'lumotlari va ularning API'si, masalan health
layers.shared: UI kit, API klient, konstantalar, yordamchi funksiyalar
